description: This PHP test class file contains unit tests for the AttendanceConfigurationAPI within the OrangeHRM Attendance plugin. It tests retrieving ('getOne'), updating ('update'), and deletion ('delete') of attendance configuration settings, utilizing fixtures and mocking services. It is part of the API testing suite specific to the attendance module.
